email.subject: Radiator leaking onto bedroom floor
email.body: Hello, the radiator in the back bedroom has been leaking onto the floor since last night. I've put towels down but it keeps coming back. Could someone take a look this week? Thanks, James, Pelican Court

email.subject: Gas smell in kitchen
email.body: Hi, I need someone urgently. There's a strong gas smell coming from around the kitchen stove. It's been getting stronger over the last hour. I've turned off the stove and cracked a window but I'm worried. Can someone come check this today? — Maria, Pelican Court

email.subject: Dishwasher not draining
email.body: Hi, my dishwasher fills with water but won't drain — there's standing water pooling at the bottom after every cycle. Started two days ago. Let me know when someone can come take a look. Kevin, Unit 8B

email.subject: Noise complaint – upstairs neighbor
email.body: Hi, the neighbors upstairs have been really loud again late at night this week. Wondering if building management could send a reminder about quiet hours? Thanks, Sara

email.subject: Can I paint the living room?
email.body: Hi, I was hoping to paint the living room a light blue. I noticed the lease doesn't specify any restrictions on paint colors. I'm happy to restore it to the original color when I move out. Let me know if that's alright. Thanks, Priya, Unit 3C

email.subject: AC unit not cooling
email.body: Hello, the AC unit has stopped cooling properly over the past two days. It's just blowing warm air now. It's been quite uncomfortable. Could someone take a look soon? Yuna, Unit 5
